starts.name: scan_point_restart
starts.definition: restart from run 2 of entry 'scan_point' of data/vector_sector/joint_vector_isospin_breaking_vpp_fit.json (lowest (4,128,128) chi2, accepted or not): its 35-coordinate endpoint, r free, same bounds; single start, no basin switch.

restart_source.run_message: The maximum number of function evaluations is exceeded.

added_coordinate_scale_definition: reciprocal Jacobian column norms of r1, r2, r3 at the zero_control start, fit order (assumption); first 32 from the endpoint comparison
degrees_of_freedom_counting: retained residual rows minus free coordinates; per-block p-values use the row count (assumption)
shift_definition: (baseline coordinates converted to the baseline reference point - best endpoint) / baseline (4,128,128) local errors; r reported in GeV^-2
near_singular_definition: SVD of the fit-order Jacobian times optimizer scales; relative singular value below 1e-06; run then labelled conditional
acceptance_rule: optimizer success and certified quadrature ladder {'energy': [2, 4], 'pair': [64, 128], 'angle': [64, 128]} with tolerances {'prediction_sigma': 0.01, 'residual': 0.01, 'jacobian_relative': 0.001, 'jacobian_absolute': 0.001, 'jacobian_negligible': 1e-12, 'chi2': 0.01}
basin_switch_rule: scaled distance (32 baseline coordinates) > 1.0: refit from the other three accepted endpoints; selected run = lowest high-order chi2 among accepted runs
adequacy_criterion: total nominal p > 0.01 and no block with nominal p < 0.001 (row count as block dof), at (4,128,128)
control_rule: zero_control reproduces the baseline: scaled distance <= 0.01 and |chi2 - baseline| <= 0.01

local_errors.definition: sqrt(diag((J^T J)^-1)) of the free coordinates from the (4,128,128) Jacobian; linearized, not profile intervals

derivative_settings.method: analytic odd columns; forward differences for remaining columns

quadrature_refinement.pole_mapping: phi s-pole mapping and both Kstar t/u-pole mappings
